caption: The drawing features a square textile or quilt design with a prominent floral motif. The central area is filled with stems that branch out diagonally bearing pink and orange flowers with pointed petals and elongated green leaves. The outer border consists of a wide band forming a repeating scalloped pattern, within which smaller pink and orange flowers and green leaves are placed. At the intersections of the scallops, there are three elongated pink tassels. The entire design is rendered on a cream or light beige background, with the main colors being light green for the leaves and border, pink and orange for the flowers, and pink for the tassels. Fine linework is used for the details and outlines of the botanical elements. The artist’s signature, “Dexter Brown, 1909,” is located at the bottom right of the page.
title: Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
